operational_review.cost_difference_note: The local estimate uses the frozen per-token catalog prices; the aggregate separately preserves the provider-reported cost.

starting_role.finding: GLM interpreted starting as a stance that must exist before the first visible endpoint, then declared e001-e005 to be the initial position rather than the requested starting endpoint. e003-e005 were therefore lost.

current_role.finding: Two e049-only records preserved the pilot leaning and headline approval but omitted e050 framing, e051 widget willingness, and e051 stop thresholds. The second record also promoted one condition inside a leaning to commitment.

qualification_role.finding: GLM dismissed user e052 as uncertainty rather than a qualification and assistant e053-e056 as commentary rather than conversation-state qualifications. Protected e056 was lost.

record_grouping.finding: The only nonempty role again became two one-alias, one-component records. A stronger different-family model did not recover coherent role identity.

relationship.finding: The frozen contract correctly blocked the relationship call because starting and qualification returned reviewed-empty outputs.

required_clarifications: Starting means the earliest visible endpoint position, not a pre-conversation state.
One role record is one coherent position thread; aliases and objects are components inside it, not separate records.
Qualification includes user-unresolved conditions and assistant-introduced process limits while preserving speaker ownership and non-endorsement.
All focal aliases must be reviewed before returning a valid empty role.

non_claims: GLM 5.2 is not globally worse than DeepSeek V4 Flash.
One same-case control does not isolate every model and provider effect.
The prospective contract clarification is not automatically validated by this failure.
No production, graph, runtime, or downstream value claim follows.
